theme: Lambeth SADPD Inspector and 13-site proposal state
facts: Lambeth received the SADPD Inspector's Report on 3 March 2026.
The SADPD includes site-specific planning policies for 13 sites proposed for allocation.
The SADPD becomes part of the statutory development plan only once adopted.
The proposed submission version was submitted for examination on 31 October 2024.
Inspector report and main modifications are publicly available.
Inspector report states three of the 13 sites already have allocations in the Lambeth Local Plan.
Those three are Royal Street site 1, Gabriel's/Princes Wharf site 9 and Norwood Road site 18.
Existing allocations for those three would be superseded on SADPD adoption.
Other existing Lambeth Local Plan allocations are unaffected by the SADPD.
Site 7 is 6-12 Kennington Lane and Wooden Spoon House.
